label: Adult female hypnotized by anyone — PH/ID first + worldwide gap check (26 Nov 2026)
group_title: Adult woman hypnotized (by a partner, villain, criminal, doctor, sorceress or charm), including forced hypnosis
description: Sweep on 26 Nov 2026 PT (user requests t88u + t91u). It covers adult female characters only who are hypnotized or put in a trance by anyone, forced or therapeutic, with the Philippines and Indonesia searched first, then any language worldwide (TV, soaps, films, shorts, anime, adult/erotic, vertical/AI, TikTok/Instagram via public indexing). Mind manipulation, gaslighting, persuasion and possession are excluded; love charms (gayuma/pelet) and psychic compulsion are tagged 'loose fit'. Each card records who hypnotizes her and whether it was forced, marriage status, children together and prior children, from the cited sources or 'unknown'. Existing categories are reused; titles already on site only gain episodes and links.

followup_social_ai_nov26.tiktok: Public TikTok discover pages ('hypnotized wife', 'hypnosis on my wife', 'girls hypnotized to be controlled', 'istri dihipnotis', 'gayuma') don't render captions for a logged-out fetch. Search indexing found only the @randomtaleshour recap 'Toxic Marriage Drama: A Tale of Mind Control and Revenge', which matches 'Listen To Your Husband' (already on site), and a Kwai 'Dihipnotis Pacar' skit playlist with no identifiable production or ages. Nothing new added.
followup_social_ai_nov26.instagram: Indexed reels were real-person hypnosis or 'seduction technique' promos (e.g. Risman Darmawan 'Teknik HIPNOTIS WANITA') plus Uya Kuya clips. No scripted female-hypnosis drama.
followup_social_ai_nov26.ai: No AI-generated series with an adult hypnotized woman could be verified this pass. 引她入梦's contradictory listings look machine-written but were not confirmed as AI. Chinese vertical hypnosis dramas with Indonesian dubs (Rahasia sang Hipnotis, Dewa Hipnotis) were already reviewed on 18 Nov (male leads, not Indonesian productions).
followup_social_ai_nov26.method: Gap checks run 26 Nov 2026 PT against main at 9e40571: (1) all 2,248 Mental Block 'Hypnotized Female' pages diffed against the catalog (619 not on site; mostly comics, games, kids or teens); (2) Mental Block full-text search for PH/ID/regional terms; (3) English Wikipedia phrase search ('hypnotizes her', 'puts her in a trance', etc.); (4) IMDb keyword 'hypnotized-woman' (986 titles, 100 not on site, screened); (5) TMDB hypnosis keywords; (6) targeted PH (gayuma/hipnotismo) and ID (hipnotis/gendam/pelet) web searches.
